name: Ujaas Energy Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1999, Ujaas Energy Ltd is engaged in generation of solar power and manufacturing, sales and services of solar power plants/projects and manufacturing and sales of Electric Vehicle
keyPoints:
Business Overview
Ujaas is one of the leading solution providers in the Indian solar power sector focused on developing, operating, owning, and maintaining a diversified portfolio of solar energy power plants under its flagship brand 'UJAAS'. [1]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 21.3% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 45.3 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -11.9% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 13.4% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.8.50 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 324 days.
Working capital days have increased from -207 days to 333 days
